messages:
Elena (CSE): Hey team — BrightPath (healthcare analytics) just sent a 28-page vendor risk questionnaire + DPA addendum. They specifically asked for our SOC2 report and answers about PHI handling. Need triage and owners. Deadline: EOD Friday. @Mason @Priya can you PTAL? Link to their form: https://vendor.brightpath.com/forms/xyz

Mason (Security): On it. Do we know if they're asking for SOC2 Type II report or just a summary? Also need scope (prod vs test). :eyes:

Priya (Legal): I'll take the DPA redline. Quick Q — are we processing PHI for them? If yes we need a BAA. My initial read: most hosted customers don't send PHI unless on Private. @Elena do we have onboarding notes on data types?

Elena (CSE): They mentioned "patient-identifiable outcomes" in the email, so could be PHI or pseudonymized. I'll ask BrightPath for sample fields. Timeline reminder: their deadline is Friday (5 days).

Raj (CSE): I'll start drafting answers for the standard VRA sections (access control, encryption, incident response, backups). Mason — can you confirm encryption and key management details so I can include exact wording?

security-bot: SOC2 report located: s3://redwood-compliance/soc2/2024-09-type2.zip

Mason (Security): Encryption details: AES‑256 at rest (AWS KMS), TLS 1.2+ in transit. Keys by default are AWS‑managed; customer-managed KMS only for Private deployments. Suggested answer snippet for Q12:

```
All customer data is encrypted at rest using AES-256 with keys managed in AWS KMS. In-transit encryption uses TLS 1.2 or higher. Access to keys and key usage is restricted by IAM policies and logged via CloudTrail.
```

Priya (Legal): For the DPA subprocessing clause we should clarify Hosted vs Private behavior (who controls keys). If they claim PHI we'll ask them to sign our BAA; I'll prepare a BAA + redline of their addendum.

Elena (CSE): Plan: Raj drafts VRA answers by Wed EOD; Priya prepares DPA redline/BAA by Thu; Mason & Lina to confirm technical evidence (MFA screenshots, key config) by Thu noon. I'll reply to BrightPath to ask for sample schema and whether they classify data as PHI. Any objections?

Mason (Security): :thumbsup: sounds good.

Lina (Compliance): I'll review Thu afternoon. Please include MFA enforcement evidence and a sample of audit logs (redacted).

Raj (CSE): Will attach MFA screenshots and redacted audit logs. Also including our incident response summary and retention table.

Priya (Legal): I'll also attach the SOC2 summary and privacy whitepaper to speed their review.

Elena (CSE): Great. I'll message BrightPath now with a short questionnaire:
- Are you sending PHI? If so, please confirm and provide example fields
- Compliance contact
- Desired contract timeline

I'll post their reply here.

Elena (CSE): Update incoming from BrightPath — they replied with fields: patient_id, timestamp, outcome_code, provider_id. They say data is pseudonymized but they consider it PHI. They requested a BAA and asked for our SOC2 Type II report. Link to their questionnaire: https://vendorforms.brightpath.com/12345

Priya (Legal): OK, we will send our BAA template and the SOC2 summary. I'll ask them to confirm legal authority to share PHI and add a scoping statement. Also request Data Minimization confirmation.

Elena (CSE): Filing internal ticket VRA-4832 and will upload initial drafts there. I'll update this thread after Raj posts the draft answers. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
